blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The observance of All Saints’ Day and All Souls’ Day, or Undas, in the Philippines is not traditionally quiet. It is nearly a weeklong commemoration of deceased loved ones, with many people willing to travel from north to south and vice versa just to pay tribute to the dead. Undas is also one of the few times of the year when relatives gather to remember people with whom they once spent holidays, whether a year ago or 10 years ago.
